reviews.comment: Avoid. Doesn't explain anything. Makes many mistakes during lectures which he never admits. Not knowledgeable. Inaccessible.

Dr. Shetty has a strong technical background and is a solid professor. Quizzes are worth 10% of your grade; we had 7 quizzes total so go to each class. Exams and grading were fair. The midterm exam averages were between 70-80. He replaces the midterms with the final exam if it's higher but as a forewarning, the final exam average was a 64.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kinetics Fall 2024. 80% exams (40% final). 20% participation quizzes and homework. Shetty was nice however very inaccessible outside of class. Tests were similar to homework problems we had. Curved in the end where an 83ish was an A. Read the book and do the hw.

With this professor, you will learn nothing and waste your time and money. He is arrogant, disorganized, does not show up to office hours, hardly ever answers emails, and does not care. He makes mistakes in lecture and refuses to admit them because "it comes very easy to him" and his mistakes "cancel each other out". Have fun when the exam comes:D

Nice guy. Needs to learn how to teach. Gave us very long exams for a short time period with so many parts. Yeah, I get it, this is a hard class. Dude rushed through the whole semester. We had like 2 weeks of review before the final, but no one knew what the hell was going on the whole time. Had a ridiculous bimodal distribution then gave like 8% A.

Given that this was his first year teaching ever, he was fine. Definitely stays true to the textbook so be prepared to read that for a lot of the learning. He's a good guy, just very difficult material to teach. Gave a good curve at the end though.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Open book open notes exams, but he's just not particularly good at teaching. Group homework. Gives quizzes, including in-class without notice but he drops lowest and his grading system is really strange so you don't have to go every day if you don't want to.
